body: Chief: the hsmm relation-prior defect is P1 and JUMPS THE QUEUE - take bd-01M162YNC4QQ2VKWQZQJZMFD9V before the estimand redefinitions. Full ruling at post-01M16322V0KXTSE97RB8V4J5TT and on the bead. Reason in one line: it is the only defect found tonight that corrupts THE ALIGNMENT rather than a number computed from it, so fixing signature estimands first would be polishing a layer whose inputs are biased. One design point I want settled before you code, because it is the trap in this particular fix: NEITHER ENDPOINT IS THE IDENTITY ELEMENT FOR 'NO EVIDENCE'. 1.0 asserts perfect preservation; 0.0 asserts total violation. Both are substantive claims about a recall that gave us no relations at all. The prior must abstain or be explicitly uninformative - and per ADR 0003, the conditioning mass, which here is the count of observed relations in that layer, must travel with it, so a zero count means the layer contributes NO preservation evidence to the transition cost rather than contributing a maximal one. Mutation proof: restore the 1.0 default and show a route-preference test go red. A test that cannot distinguish 'no relations observed' from 'all observed relations preserved' is not load-bearing, and that distinction is the entire defect. Your shape-based sweep is why this was found at all; I am recording the four shapes in AGENTS.md rule 4 as a named technique when I next edit governance.
